Emily (PM - Webinar): Heads up — prelaunch SEO checklist for Tuesday's webinar landing + post-event asset pack. Can we align on keywords, schema, internal link plan, and lead routing? cc @Lex @Maria

Lex (SEO): Quick wins: canonical the on-demand recording at /resources/webinars/redwood-inference-launch, add VideoObject JSON-LD, include transcript (searchable), ensure 3 CTAs above the fold + 1 sticky CTA. Also add structured FAQ and speakable markup where appropriate.

Maria (Growth): :thumbsup: Lead routing: use UTM template `utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch2024`. Hidden form field `origin=webinar-registration` to map to our CRM. Post-event registrants -> nurture flow tag `webinar-attendee`.

Kevin (Content): I'll fold the benchmark narrative into the post and create 2 headline variants for A/B tests. Need the KW list and priority intent from you, @Lex.

Lex (SEO): Top KW targets (priority): `redwood inference benchmark`, `LLM inference cost comparison`, `low-latency LLM serving`, `webinar LLM deployment best practices`, `on-prem inference platform`. Intent tags: info, comparison, how-to, product.

SEO Bot: schema-check: VideoObject JSON-LD present ✓, FAQPage present ✓, mobile-preview passes. (automated scan 2024-03-21)

Emily (PM - Webinar): Cross-link plan: product landing -> webinar resource -> benchmark post -> case study. Add contextual links in the benchmark to product pages (capabilities + pricing) and to docs for Dedicated/Private. Keep 3-4 in-body links.

Maria (Growth): Also add an internal anchor list at top for timestamps + resource links so email drives to anchors. For sitemaps: add `<url><loc>https://redwood.example/resources/webinars/redwood-inference-launch</loc><priority>0.8</priority></url>` and ping search console after publish. Example ping:
```
curl "https://www.google.com/ping?sitemap=https://redwood.example/sitemap.xml"
```

Kevin (Content): Draft ready for review: https://staging.redwood.example/webinars/launch-preview. Will publish Tue 10:00 PST. Who's owning canonical header + rel=next/prev for paginated transcript?

Lex (SEO): I'll own canonical and param handling. Reminder: canonicalize query params `?utm_*` and `?ref`, do not block them in robots. Also set `Cache-Control: max-age=86400` on the landing for CDNs.

Emily (PM - Webinar): Perfect. Action items: Kevin publish draft, Lex add JSON-LD + canonical + robots check, Maria prepare UTM + CRM mapping + email anchors. Follow-up sync tomorrow 9am. :rocket:
